title: WALKWAY TUBE (the base's tubes: 4.35 m between two door spot collars)
height: tube radius 1.6 m, axis 1.1 m above the deck: deck 2.3 m wide, glass band each side from 38 to 104 degrees off the crown, up to 2.7 m
doors: COLLAR at the near end (2.2 x 2.6 m)
COLLAR at the far end (2.2 x 2.6 m)
items: PIPES AND CABLES low and high
notes: Section from the old plan (the base's tubes: radius 1.6 m, axis 1.1 m over the deck, a hoop every 1.3 m); its length the base's tubes' 4.35 m (the east and west tubes between the hub and its neighbours, data/scene/tube.json's tube_length, which the joined tubes stretch). Frame: x across, z along from the near end, as the walkway tube's kit lays it.

The place is the west tube, seated on the Moon ground between the greenhouse's east hatch (its near end) and the hub's tube door at bearing 90 (its far end); every other tube is this stage stood and stretched in its rooms' records.
Glossary: a deck, a hull roof against the Sun and the dust, a band of glass down each side, a strip light along its crown; carries power and air.

concept.read: the concept K12 read element by element in the inventory's concept_elements (data/inventory/tube.json), each element mapped to its rows or dropped with its reason
